answers.question: PART 1 — LANGUAGE IN FUNCTIONAL TEXTS Questions 1–6 Read the following text and choose the best answer to indicate the option that best fits each numbered blank from 1 to 6. GENERATION STORIES PROJECT People from different generations often know less about one another's experiences than they realise. Our Generation Stories Project invites students to interview an older relative or community member and create a short profile. Before recording an interview, participants (1) [Blank 1] ask the interviewee for permission. This is a project requirement. Your interviewee may hold opinions that differ from yours, but you (2) [Blank 2] agree with every view you hear. The aim is to understand the person's experiences rather than judge them. Each participant will (3) [Blank 3] submit a 250-word profile at the end of the project. When writing, avoid (4) [Blank 4] people simply because of their age. Instead, explain the experiences that may have influenced their beliefs. Students are also encouraged to identify one (5) [Blank 5] characteristic or interest that they share with the person they interviewed. (6) [Blank 6] , selected profiles will be displayed at our Community Stories Exhibition.📋BẢNG LỰA CHỌN CÁC Ô TRỐNG (CLOZE OPTIONS):Ô (1):A.shouldB.have toC.don't have toD.mustn'tÔ (2):A.have toB.mustn'tC.don't have toD.shouldÔ (3):A.mustn'tB.have toC.had toD.shouldn'tÔ (4):A.sharingB.interviewingC.followingD.judgingÔ (5):A.traditionalB.commonC.culturalD.fixedÔ (6):A.For exampleB.OtherwiseC.AfterwardsD.However

His father began to see that a closed door did not automatically mean rejection of family time.B. Huy therefore decided that family members should never enter one another's rooms.C. His parents concluded that teenagers were always more responsible when left completely alone.D. The family stopped discussing privacy because the issue had become too difficult.Write A, B, C, or D - {#4}Question 17.A.
